description: Pure-Lean aggregate_with_stats input/statement/hints pipeline, pluggable CLI prover, Rust e2e-oracle (trace export / serialized-proof verify / Ethereum wire verify / fresh inputs / benchmark), Tier B alternating benchmark runner with stats and RSS capture.
axiom_audit: CLI_STRICT_AUDIT_COUNT 130, CLI_STRICT_AUDIT_REJECTIONS 0 (LEAN_PATH=.lake/build/lib/lean lean Tests/Cli/AxiomAudit.lean; axioms within [propext, Quot.sound])
spec_frozen: all 20 Spec/**/*.lean SHA-256 identical to the pre-edit baseline
e2e_oracle_subcommands: verify-vm <case> <proof.bin> (3 verify passes, ms, proof bytes, non-zero exit on tamper)
export-eth-proof <dir> <out.bin> (aggregate + wire round trip + mirror statement)
verify-eth <xmss-inputs.bin> <eth-proof.bin> (3 verify passes, wire bytes, proof_size())

tier_b.protocol: alternating fresh-process pairs (5 per fixture), --repeat 3, --log-inv-rate 1, 2s cooldown; per-pass unrounded nanos; arithmetic mean / sample stddev / 95% CI; ru_maxrss via /usr/bin/time -v; statements match across implementations; Rust verification ok
tier_b.smoke: Rust-vs-Rust dry-run + Lean CLI stub on xmss4 (2 pairs) PASS

key_results.cpu_proof_roundtrip: bincode fixint serialized CPU proofs verify 3x from file (xmss4 240912 B, xmss16 proof bytes recorded in evidence); a tampered proof byte is rejected with non-zero exit
key_results.e2e_eth_xmss4: export-eth-proof + verify-eth from xmss-inputs.bin alone PASS, wire_bytes=270681 proof_size()=270120
key_results.fresh_inputs: gen-fresh-inputs <count> <seed> <dir>: fresh mock (pk, message, sig) records, Lean CLI reproduces statement + hints + VM execution
key_results.trace_walks: phase-by-phase scalar counts close each proof stream exactly (announce/l0_root/bus_gkr/bus_memory/constraints_scalars/table_evals/r_pi/keccak_scalars/ring_switch_scalars/whir_scalars), one Merkle batch per WHIR level; traces additionally record bus_scalars, whir rounds, merkle_bytes, proof_size, ethereum_proof_wire_bytes
